title: Participants conclude U.S. hosted 8th Pacific Search and Rescue workshop
description: Participants conclude this years 8th Pacific Regional Maritime Search and Rescue workshop consisting of seminars and a Search and Rescue demonstration in Hawaii, July 26, 2019. The United States hosted this year's event with more than 15 countries to discuss search and rescue throughout the Pacific Region. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Matthew West
keywords: partners, District 14, Sector Honolulu, PACSAR8, Coast Guard, Hawaii, SAR
